output.headline: Advocate Health has bought five times in the target's own sub-sector, closed every deal, and ranks first on the priority list.
output.differentiator: Most deals in the target's own sub-sector of any buyer on the priority list (5, all closed), plus a strategic's synergy headroom of $15M-$25M. [T:record, V:synergy]
output.why_them: Sub-sector specialist strategic; five of five deals closed

acquirer_overview.title: A nonprofit hospital system with a closed record in this sector
points: Nonprofit system headquartered in Charlotte, NC, with 69 hospitals (2024), created by the merger of Advocate Aurora Health and Atrium Health. [P:1, P:2, P:3]
Five deals from 2016 to 2023, all closed, all control deals, all in Healthcare Services; 2 since 2022. [T:record, K:closed_share, K:control_share, K:recent]
Several precedents were booked under the Atrium Health name before the merger, so the record spans both legacy systems. [D:MA-2023-0330, D:MA-2020-0408, D:MA-2016-0065]

strategic_fit_thesis.title: A sub-sector specialist whose motives are platform building and scale
points: Share of deals in the target's sub-sector is the strongest factor; target margin close to what it usually buys is a strong factor. [S:sector_share, S:margin_fit]
Platform Build drove 2 of 5 deals and Scale 2 of 5, well above their share of all deals in the file. [M:platform_build, M:scale]
Geography is a slight factor against: one deal in the target's region, Apex Medical Group ($1,920M, 2016). [S:geo_fit, D:MA-2016-0065]

precedent_activity.title: Large platform deals, with a small buy and a mid-size buy showing range
points: Charter Care Partners: $2,022M Platform Investment, 2023, at 18.5x. Granite Care: $336M Platform Investment, 2020, at 13.6x. [D:MA-2023-0330, D:MA-2020-0408]
Silver Health Partners: $35M Leveraged Buyout, 2022, at 13.8x. Hudson Medical Group: $436M Strategic Acquisition, 2020, at 9.3x. [D:MA-2022-0311, D:MA-2020-0496]
Only 1 of 5 deals falls in the comparable $100M-$400M size band. [K:size_band]

valuation_context.title: Upper-quartile pricing is defensible and synergy headroom supports it
points: Comparable deals: 10.7x at the 25th percentile, 12.8x median, 15.3x at the 75th, across 70 deals (9 in the same sub-sector). [V:comps]
The 75th percentile is justified because the target's 16.8% margin sits above the comparable median of 12.9%. [V:comps]
Advocate's own median paid is 13.8x. Synergy headroom is $15M-$25M (half of cost synergies realised); buyer revenue not researched. [V:comps, V:synergy]

risk_flags.title: Size mismatch
risk_flags.concern: Typical deal is far larger than the $200M target; only 1 of 5 sits in the comparable size band.
risk_flags.mitigant: It has bought small ($35M) and mid-size ($336M) assets.
risk_flags.reality: Median deal of $436M means the target is below its usual scale. [T:record, K:size_band]

risk_flags.title: Thin Midwest record
risk_flags.concern: Geography is a slight factor against; the target is in the Midwest.
risk_flags.mitigant: It did a Midwest deal (Apex Medical Group, 2016) and its footprint includes Illinois and Wisconsin.
risk_flags.reality: One deal in the target's region, and it dates from 2016. [S:geo_fit, D:MA-2016-0065, P:2]

risk_flags.title: Price gap in a contested process
risk_flags.concern: Financial sponsors on the priority list with heavier Midwest records may bid above Advocate's usual level.
risk_flags.mitigant: Synergy headroom of $15M-$25M supports a strategic bid.
risk_flags.reality: Its median paid of 13.8x sits below the 15.3x comparable 75th percentile. [T:record, V:comps, V:synergy]

conviction.rationale: Five deals in the target's own sub-sector and none adjacent, one deal in the target's region, and a first-place rank among the highest-scored buyers left after review. [T:record, R:rank, C:conviction]
